demo.title: demo.sh
demo.code:
# Active Quotient signals updated by Q in the last 24h
./scripts/quotient.sh signals

# The featured signal
./scripts/quotient.sh featured

# Hold-or-sell read on a Polymarket wallet
./scripts/converge-monitor.sh 0xYourPolymarketWallet

setup: Log in to the Bankr CLI and fund a payment option advertised by the runtime PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge: Base USDC or Robinhood Chain USDG. Confirm the installed client supports the selected offer (see references/vanilla-x402-flow.md).
To pay USDG, require scheme exact on eip155:4663 with the canonical 6-decimal asset 0x5fc5360D0400a0Fd4f2af552ADD042D716F1d168; match network and asset, not symbol alone.

Paid reads are confirmation-first: with no autopay policy the scripts print a cost preview and exit 10; relay it, then re-run with --approve <token>, or on the user's explicit acceptance pre-authorize with `./scripts/quotient.sh autopay init --total-budget 1.00` (see SKILL.md, Paid Calls).

Trade execution is two-phase: `signal-strategy.mjs --execute` previews a hashed plan (exit 12) with the risk disclosure; only `--execute --confirm <hash>` submits, then verifies on-chain receipts and position changes.
Optional: `bankr login email <addr> --code <otp> --accept-terms --agent-api --read-write` and export BANKR_API_KEY if you want signal-strategy.mjs to execute (default is dry-run).
